//: Lighthouse CI lab gate for the Grove performance budget (GOL-866, spec GOL-864 §1a/§1b). Runs against a live preview URL. Thresholds mirror perf-budget.config.json → lighthouse; keep the two in sync. INP has no lab equivalent, so total-blocking-time is the documented lab proxy.

collect.//settings: Mobile is Lighthouse's DEFAULT (formFactor=mobile, simulated Slow-4G + 4x CPU slowdown) — exactly the '4G mobile' target in §1a; no settings.preset needed. NEVER set preset: 'mobile' — the CLI's --preset only accepts perf | experimental | desktop and rejects 'mobile' outright, which made every real collect fail (first seen on the 2026-09-08 dispatch against QA). Median of 3 runs absorbs lab variance.
